# Reference normalization fixture

A reference is a user-facing six-character identifier. This fixture has no network,
external services, or persistence. The stub returns input unchanged.

Settled contract: strip surrounding whitespace, uppercase ASCII letters, require
exactly six ASCII letters or digits, reject other characters with ValueError.
Tests are authoritative and must not be edited. The remaining design choice is the
error wording: one uniform invalid-reference message, or distinct reasons per error.
Use python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -v for verification.

def normalize_reference(value: str) -> str:
    return value
